method: Read-only static source plus isolated SHA-pinned function probes with explicit mocks; no original app execution

results.name: All scans the entire dataset and duplicate marks remain unique
Unmark This uses the source row and source repeater
Rule targets every row, retains source Item, restores target, and mutates after selection
Item marked metadata is event snapshot; TargetItem is a live membership read
Item outside a row falls back to TargetItem
Marked is not a dedicated Mark/Unmark target branch
Update Marked touches all marked source rows and preserves marks
Deleting an unmarked predecessor preserves the remaining marked row identities
Delete Marked copies the target set, deletes descending, and removes deleted marks

limitations: DOM, renderer, generated action JSON, and full event scheduler are mocked or absent.
Does not prove original-browser UI behavior, generator spelling normalization, or same-event deletion-map edge cases.
